content.text: A Toyota SUV stands ready, whether you're cruising through the city or exploring rugged terrains. Start exploring Toyota SUV models and build your own today. Land Cruiser shown in Heritage Blue with Grayscape roof. Extra-cost color with available Premium Package and 20-in. alloy wheels. Prototype shown with options. Production model may vary. Land Cruiser Adventure is redefined with the Toyota Land Cruiser. This iconic Toyota SUV combines heritage styling with a powerful i-FORCE MAX Hybrid Powertrain that delivers 326 horsepower. Ready for your next expedition? The Land Cruiser awaits. Explore Land Cruiser Platinum AWD shown in Wind Chill Pearl. Extra-cost color. Prototype vehicle shown with options. Grand Highlander Meet the Toyota Grand Highlander, an SUV built for creating lasting memories. Comfortably seating up to eight, this mid-size Toyota SUV blends comfort and practicality, with a towing capacity of up to 5,000 lbs.* With the latest tech onboard, the Grand Highlander keeps you connected and entertained on the road. Explore Grand Highlander Platinum Hybrid MAX shown in Storm Cloud.* Prototype vehicle shown with options. Grand Highlander Hybrid Maximize your adventures with the Toyota Grand Highlander Hybrid. Opt for the standard Hybrid powertrain for an impressive fuel efficiency EPA-estimated rating of up to 36 mpg combined,* or the Hybrid MAX for a spirited drive with up to 362 combined system net horsepower. With available all-wheel drive, it's ready to tackle diverse road challenges.
